graft.title: A CI workflow every project gets, running tend check --strict
graft.need: A GitHub Actions workflow the baseline renders into each project (tend baseline render), that gets a tend binary and runs `tend check --strict`: signed batches, links and doc tags, the baseline's rules, and the license model (rendered files, manifest expression, dependencies against the combo's options, DCO sign-offs). It must fetch the tend release itself (gh release download with a token secret) rather than `uses:` tend's check action: a public repo can never use an action from a private one. Today each project hand-writes this job, and autodyne had to take it out.
graft.use_case: autodyne moved its license gating (the CLA workflow, cargo-deny's license list) to tend check, so CI only gates licenses again once tend check runs there; every project on the library combo needs the same job.
waits_on: tend published on GitHub with releases

answer.text: Declined by the user's decision (2026-10-31): no project runs CI unless it's open to contributions (declared per project, closed by default), and none is open yet. GitHub Actions is off on autodyne and ten other repos. `tend check --strict` runs before every commit from the pre-commit hook (`tend code hook --install`) instead, and that is the record. If a project opens, the baseline renders its CI then (rule ci.contributors-only).

group.title: What every project's CI gets from the baseline
